title: OpenPlanr stack.md required keys (v1.0.0)
description: JSON Schema for the canonical key set extracted from input/tech/stack.md. The stack file is YAML-in-markdown; consumers extract the keys into a single flat object before validation. BuildCommand, TestCommand, Language, Framework, and ORM are required (ORM may be empty string for stacks without a database).

schemaVersion.description: Pinned to the OpenPlanr Protocol reader version.

Language.description: Primary backend language (e.g. TypeScript, Python, JavaScript (Node ESM)). May be empty for non-applicable stacks.

Framework.description: Backend framework or runtime (e.g. NestJS, Next.js, Claude Code plugin). May be empty when not applicable.

TestFramework.description: Backend test framework (e.g. Vitest, Jest, pytest, node:test).

DatabaseType.description: Database engine (e.g. postgres, mysql, sqlite). Empty when no DB.

DatabasePassword.description: Database password (typically a secret reference, not a literal).

ORM.description: ORM (e.g. Prisma, TypeORM, Drizzle, EF Core, SQLAlchemy). Empty string is valid when the project has no DB.

MigrationTool.description: Migration tool (e.g. prisma migrate, alembic, knex).

UIFramework.description: Frontend UI framework (e.g. React, Vue, SolidJS).

CSSStrategy.description: CSS approach (e.g. Tailwind, CSS Modules, styled-components).

StateManagement.description: State management library (e.g. Zustand, Redux Toolkit, TanStack Query).

FormLibrary.description: Form library (e.g. React Hook Form, Formik).

CIProvider.description: CI provider (e.g. GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, CircleCI).

CloudProvider.description: Cloud provider (e.g. AWS, GCP, Azure, Vercel, Fly.io).

SecretManagement.description: Secret manager (e.g. AWS Secrets Manager, Vault, .env).

NamingConvention.description: Code naming conventions across files, components, functions, constants, and database identifiers.

FolderStructure.description: Folder structure style (e.g. domain-based, feature-based, type-based).

BuildCommand.description: Shell command DEV agents run during the correction loop. Must exit 0 for a clean build.

TestCommand.description: Shell command DEV agents run during the correction loop. Must exit 0 for a clean test pass.

LintCommand.description: Optional lint command. When non-empty, must exit 0.

TypeCheckCommand.description: Optional type-check command. When non-empty, must exit 0.

ActiveStackFiles.description: Resolved paths to active stack overlay files (e.g. backend/nestjs.md, database/prisma.md). Empty array when none.

MustPreserve.description: Files or invariants agents must never modify.
